rows.jyutping: lo2 dou2 N ge3 gwo3 cing4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to describe the process of obtaining something as a noun.

example.english: This form clearly explains the acquisition process for the job.
example.traditional: 呢份表格講清楚攞到份工嘅過程。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 gong2 cing1 co2 lo2 dou2 fan6 gung1 ge3 gwo3 cing4

rows.note: Use this for something gained or achieved, especially a rewarding result rather than just any object bought.

example.english: The biggest acquisition from this trip was meeting a few good friends.
example.traditional: 今次旅行最大嘅收穫係識到幾個好朋友。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 sau1 wok6 hai6 sik1 dou2 gei2 go3 hou2 pang4 jau5
